name: Constant Technologies
old_description: As a command center solution provider, we focus exclusively on mission-critical projects, with an unrivaled depth of knowledge that enables us to consistently deliver high-performing command centers. We work to earn your trust by making every experience with Constant exceptional.
about:
Constant Technologies is headquartered in North Kingstown, Rhode Island, and has spent more than 40 years focusing exclusively on mission-critical command and control centers. The company was founded as a specialist in video wall solutions and control room furniture, growing into a global provider that designs, manufactures, and integrates complete operations centers. President Brad Righi leads a team that includes AIA-certified architects and CTS-D-accredited audiovisual engineers.

The firm manufactures its own console workstations and delivers turnkey projects that span discovery, design, execution, commissioning, and 24/7 support. Its in-house capabilities cover engineered documentation, site surveys, racking, programming, and preventive maintenance. To date, Constant has completed over 5,000 installations in more than 20 countries, with a global network of offices across the Americas, Europe, Africa, and Asia.

Customers span technology, finance, public safety, utilities, government, healthcare, fleet operations, brand protection, and retail. Named clients include Meta, CVS Health, Boeing, the U.S. Department of Defense, and numerous police departments such as Albany, Amarillo, and Aurora. The company tailors each center—whether a security operations center, real-time intelligence center, or fusion center—to the specific mission.

Constant says its differentiation lies in an unwavering dedication to quality ingrained in its employees and showcased in the final product, a proven process that avoids multiple-provider complexity, and a 24/7 global support network that maintains and adapts solutions as missions evolve.
